value.rationale: The full exact 2-packing polynomial classifies every cardinality layer of a natural family of cubic Hamiltonian graphs, not merely the minimum distance bound. Its mod-four parity deficit and quadratic/constant/linear extremal count are structural and furnish exact three-capacities for a recently introduced multi-agent invariant, including explicit optimal full-traversal tours. General cubic packing bounds and the ordinary ladder independence polynomial do not supply this information.
